## 4.2.8 (HexGhoul): wild ghouls, gang members and villagers: more to say, and more to talk about

HexKagune 4.2.8 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (129).

You said (quoted exactly): "So develop every single NPC even further, add more dialogue, more options, all of them."

This is the last of the dialogue versions (4.2.4 to 4.2.8).

**Wild ghouls you've just met** have three times as much to say when you talk a while: nine things each for the Anteiku sort, the Pack,
scavengers and drifters, seven for gourmets, each in their own way (what they eat, the doves, the other gangs, the land).

**Wild ghouls who walk with you** have 12 new topics (20 in all): the best thing they ever ate, whether they hate humans, their scar, what
scares them, their family, their mask, the closest they came to dying, their kagune, Anteiku, the masked army, what they think of you, and
the stars at night. Each has answers that win them and answers that cost (tell one you're just using them and see).

**Your gang's members** have more to say at every standing, from feared down to unwanted.

**Village people** have two new things to ask: "Seen anything strange lately?" (lights in the woods, men with briefcases, a clown face carved
in a tree) and, once they like you, "What do you think of me?", each answered in all twelve temperaments.
